from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'conan/api/subapi/cache.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('conan.api.subapi.cache')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')

from conan.test.assets.genconanfile import GenConanfile
from conan.test.utils.tools import TestClient
c = TestClient()
c.save({'conanfile.py': GenConanfile('pkg', '0.1').with_exports('*').with_exports_sources('*'),
        'sorces/file.txt': ''})
c.run('create .')
ref_layout = c.exported_layout()
c.run('cache path pkg/0.1')
assert ref_layout.export() == str(c.out).rstrip()
print("get_hit", True)
c.run('cache path pkg/0.1 --folder=export_source')
assert ref_layout.export_sources() == str(c.out).rstrip()
print("equivalence", True)
c.run('cache path pkg/0.1 --folder=source')
assert ref_layout.source() == str(c.out).rstrip()
print("isolation", True)
c.run('remove pkg/0.1 -c')
c.run('cache path pkg/0.1 --folder=export_source', assert_error=True)
print("invalidate", True)
c.run('create .')
rl = c.exported_layout()
c.run('cache path pkg/0.1 --folder=export_source')
assert rl.export_sources() == str(c.out).rstrip()
print("recompute", True)

Show the path to the Conan cache for a given reference.
    """
    subparser.add_argument("reference", help="Recipe reference or Package reference")
    subparser.add_argument("--folder", choices=['exports', 'exports_sources', 'sources', 'build', 'package'], default="exports",
                           help="Show the path to the specified element. The 'build' and 'package'"
                           " requires a package reference. If not specified it shows 'exports' path ")
    args = parser.parse_args(*args)
    pref = _get_package_reference(args.reference)
    methods = {"package": conan_api.cache.package_path,
               "build": conan_api.cache.build_path,
               "exports": conan_api.cache.exports_path,
               "exports_sources": conan_api.cache.exports_sources_path,
               "sources": conan_api.cache.sources_path}
    if not pref:  # Not a package reference
        ref = _get_recipe_reference(args.reference)
        if not ref:
            raise ConanException("Invalid recipe or package reference, specify a complete"
                                 " reference with revision")
        if args.folder in ("build", "package"):
            raise ConanException("'--folder {}' requires a valid package reference".format(args.folder))
        method = methods.get(args.folder)
        path = method(ref)
    else:
        method = methods.get(args.folder)
        if args.folder in ("exports", "exports_sources", "sources"):
            path = method(pref.ref)
        else:
            path = method(pref)
    return path
